output.title: IoT telemetry platform
output.description: Partitioned device telemetry feeds a low-latency state projection and streaming lake, with threshold alerts.

traffic.label: 1,000 devices check in as shifts start

action.text: Morning check-ins ramp from 100 to 300 per second. Both consumer groups receive every reading.
Only TemperatureExceeded events go to the on-call mailbox.
One partition activates one replica per group; the other 63 replicas sit idle. Lag grows despite the configured service fleet.
The partition key is redistributed; the backlog drains.
